about: Scripted exchanges and what memory extraction should store from them. A check finds the extracted record of `kind` whose name contains `name` (case-insensitive) and asserts on `field`: `any_of` passes if the field contains any listed phrase, `absent` passes if the field is empty. `field: "any"` searches every field of the record. A check with no `name` looks across all records of that kind; `count: 0` asserts there are none.

cases.player: While Aldo is at the feast, I pick the lock on his desk drawer and read whatever is inside.
cases.dm: The lock gives with a soft click. Beneath a stack of receipts lies an unsent letter in Aldo's careful hand: 'It is done. The warehouse burned as you asked. Meet me at the east bank.' It is dated the night of the fire. So much for the docks.

cases.player: Old Hesk, you run the night ferry. Did anyone from the manor come down to the docks the night of the fire?
cases.dm: Hesk scratches his beard. 'Nobody from the manor. I'd remember, they tip poorly.' He squints at you. 'Certainly not that steward, Aldo. Why, did he say he was here?'

cases.player: Captain Voss, I'll find whoever set the fire. In return you forget I was ever in that warehouse.
cases.dm: Voss spits. 'Fine. Bring me a name by the new moon and your little break-in never happened. Fail, and I remember everything.'

cases.player: I ask the steward how long he has served here.
cases.dm: Aldo Venn smooths his coat. 'Twenty years, come the harvest. I served the late Lady Ashford before her son.'

cases.player: I accept a cup of wine from Aldo and ask about the harvest.
cases.dm: Aldo pours generously. 'The best in years,' he says, and talks for some time about barley.

cases.player: I thank Mira for the stew.
cases.dm: Mira waves you off with a smile and goes back to wiping the bar.
